title: Resource entry frontmatter
description: 取得實體書的途徑（圖書館、借閱平台、書店等），由書目的 availability.physical_access 引用。當同一資源被 2 本或以上書目引用時，應由重複的純文字項目提升為此處的共用條目——邏輯與 people/ 完全相同。 / A way to obtain a physical copy of a book (library, lending app, bookstore, etc.), referenced from books' availability.physical_access. Once the same resource is cited by 2+ books, it should be promoted here from repeated plain-text entries — the exact same pattern as people/.

name.description: zh-HK canonical name — should match the name string used in books' availability.physical_access[].name before promotion, so the connection is traceable. / zh-HK canonical name — should match the name string already used in books' availability.physical_access[].name before promotion, so the link back is traceable.

books.description: GENERATED FIELD. Populated by tools/sync.js from every book's `availability.physical_access[].slug` via reverse lookup. Must not be present in committed source files — if a contributor adds it by hand, validate.js should flag this as an error, not silently accept it.
